# TL;DR: Prepare Alpha

`feature.fixture.alpha.prepare` · sub-feature of `feature.fixture.alpha` · about one minute.

## Purpose

Prepare the inputs the alpha feature finishes.

## Functionality

Collects alpha inputs; finishing belongs to the sibling sub-feature.

## Structure

```text
inputs ──▶ Prepare Alpha ──▶ prepared inputs
```

## Logic

1. Read the alpha inputs.
2. Mark them prepared.
